clue.text: English title for Macbeth? It's a gas

parts.note: Macbeth is Thane of Glamis and then of Cawdor, a Scottish noble's title

explanation.surface: A quiz question about what to call Macbeth in English, with a joking reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's a gas' reads like slang for 'it's a laugh', but it is a plain definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A simple hydrocarbon found in natural gas, so it is literally a gas.

clue.text: Sequence of actions involving oven for breakfast essential

indicators.note: involving means the first piece takes the second inside it

parts.note: a track of events is a course or sequence of actions, as in a track record
an oast is a kiln or oven for drying hops

explanation.surface: A cook planning the steps of making breakfast around the oven.
explanation.definitionFit: A rack for holding slices of toast is a fixture of the British breakfast table.

clue.text: Artist upset about the vacant position in studio

indicators.note: about means the first piece goes round the others
upset in a down clue means the letters are turned upwards, read backwards

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

indicators.note: vacant means the word is emptied of its middle, keeping its outer letters

parts.note: lie means position, as in the lie of the land

explanation.surface: A painter is upset to find the studio post empty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns RA into AR; 'vacant' empties THE to TE; AR goes 'about' TE plus LIE.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist's or designer's workshop is called by this French word.

clue.text: Spain e.g. allows flying birds

parts.note: E is the international vehicle code for Spain

indicators.note: flying means the letters are sent scattering into a new order

explanation.surface: A claim that Spain, for instance, lets birds fly.
explanation.definitionFit: These large horned owls of Europe and Asia are a kind of bird.

clue.text: Composer's traditional stuff on radio in the first place

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', linking the composer to the wordplay

indicators.note: on radio means the word is heard rather than seen, so only its sound counts

parts.note: corn is trite, old-fashioned material
gold is the medal for first place

explanation.surface: Praise for a composer whose old-fashioned work came top on the radio.
explanation.walkthrough: Erich Wolfgang Korngold was an Austrian-American composer of film scores.
explanation.definitionFit: Erich Wolfgang Korngold wrote operas and Hollywood film scores, so he is a composer.

clue.text: King over region home to 51 — as immortalised by Sibelius?

indicators.note: over in a down clue means this piece sits on top of the next

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

indicators.note: home to means the region houses the next piece inside it

parts.note: an area is a region
LI is 51 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A northern region Sibelius celebrated in music, with a royal touch.
explanation.walkthrough: Sibelius wrote the Karelia Suite about this region.
explanation.definitionFit: Sibelius composed music named after this Finnish-Russian region, making it famous.

clue.text: Losing scenarios not accepted among senior scientists

indicators.note: among means the next piece sits inside the first

parts.note: RS is the Royal Society, Britain's body of leading scientists
out means rejected or not accepted

explanation.surface: Top scientists reject scenarios in which things go badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Heavy defeats are situations where one side loses badly.

clue.text: Sensitive response seeing advancement of good display space

indicators.note: advancement means a letter is pushed further forward in the word

parts.note: an allergy is the body's sensitive reaction to something

explanation.surface: A sensitive reaction to some good being shown off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'advancement of' moves G from near the end of ALLERGY to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: A room or building where art is exhibited is a space for displays.

clue.text: Sanction one occupying flat? Not entirely

indicators.note: occupying means the piece moves in and sits inside the other
not entirely means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: level means flat
A means one

explanation.surface: A question about permission for a tenant to live in a flat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not entirely' trims LEVEL to LEVE; 'occupying' puts A inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Permission, as in leave to appeal, is a sanction given by authority.

clue.text: Claim to involve English comic-book hero or heroine

indicators.note: to involve means the claim word wraps round the next piece

parts.note: to aver is to claim

explanation.surface: Someone asserts that an English superhero belongs in the comics.
explanation.definitionFit: Marvel's superhero team members and avenging comic characters bear this name.

clue.text: University policeman, rudely called, seizing a bit of web content

indicators.note: seizing means the policeman takes hold of the next piece inside

parts.note: plod is a disparaging British slang name for a policeman

explanation.surface: A campus cop, called names, grabs a piece of internet material.
explanation.definitionFit: A file put onto the internet is a piece of web content.

clue.text: Trouble everywhere? Stumped, first of all, by that

parts.note: ST is the cricket abbreviation for stumped, placed first of all before the next piece
rife means widespread, found everywhere

explanation.surface: Trouble everywhere leaves someone stumped at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Trouble' looks like part of the question, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Conflict or discord is a form of trouble.

clue.text: Auditor set to travel aboard ship

indicators.note: aboard means the next piece goes inside the ship

parts.note: a liner is a ship

indicators.note: to travel means the letters move around into a new order

explanation.surface: An accountant gets ready for a voyage on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Auditor' suggests an accountant, but here it is used in its older sense of a hearer.
explanation.definitionFit: An auditor in the old sense is a hearer, one who listens.

clue.text: Friend quickly swapping last two peas

parts.note: marrow is northern English dialect for a mate or friend

indicators.note: swapping last two means the final pair of letters change places

parts.note: fast means quickly

explanation.surface: A friend hastily swaps the last two peas on a plate.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swapping last two' turns FAST into FATS.
explanation.definitionFit: Large dried peas, often used for mushy peas, are a variety of pea.

clue.text: Get taken off, having boarded ship? We might

definitions.text: Get taken off, having boarded ship? We might

indicators.note: having boarded means the phrase is now inside the ship

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
tow away means to have something hauled off, as a car is

explanation.surface: Hidden passengers admitting they risk being removed after sneaking on board.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and a description of people who hide on ships and may be put ashore.
explanation.definitionFit: Those hiding on board without a ticket might be put off the vessel when found.

clue.text: American giving no backing to Knight

indicators.note: backing means the word runs backwards

parts.note: nay means no
K is the chess abbreviation for knight

explanation.surface: An American refuses to support a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal British slang term for a person from the United States.

clue.text: Hispanic country about to invest in shifting grain to America not Sweden

indicators.note: to invest in means the next piece is placed inside
shifting means the letters move into a new order

parts.note: CA, short for circa, means about

indicators.note: not means the following letter is taken away

parts.note: USA is America
S is the international vehicle code for Sweden

explanation.surface: A trade story of grain shipped to America rather than to Sweden.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifting' makes NIRAG from GRAIN, with CA put in as NICARAG; USA without S gives UA.
explanation.definitionFit: This Central American nation speaks Spanish, so it is a Hispanic country.

clue.text: Avoids relinquishing power — goes downhill

indicators.note: relinquishing means giving up a letter

parts.note: skips means avoids
P is the physics abbreviation for power

explanation.surface: Someone shirking responsibility and losing power, going into decline.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes downhill' suggests decline but means gliding down a slope on snow.
explanation.definitionFit: Travelling on long runners over snow is how one descends a slope.

clue.text: Banner spurned by first river boat

indicators.note: spurned by first means the first instance of the letter is rejected

parts.note: a streamer is a long narrow banner

explanation.surface: A river boat refuses to fly a banner.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel driven by steam is a kind of boat.

clue.text: Bag and various cartons not to be touched

parts.note: a sac is a bag-like pouch

indicators.note: various means the letters are put in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A bag and assorted boxes that must be left alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Something sacred or inviolable must not be interfered with.

clue.text: What one pays to engage foremost pair of honest TV presenters?

indicators.note: to engage means the costs take the next piece inside

parts.note: costs are what one pays

indicators.note: foremost pair of means only the opening two letters are used

explanation.surface: The fee paid to hire a pair of honest television hosts.
explanation.definitionFit: People sharing the job of hosting a broadcast are joint presenters.

clue.text: A new problem involving two-thirds of the soldiers' quarters?

indicators.note: involving means the first group takes the next piece inside

parts.note: ill means a problem or trouble

indicators.note: two-thirds of means only the first two of three letters are used

explanation.surface: A fresh problem with the army's barracks.
explanation.walkthrough: Soldier ants are a caste of ant, hence the question mark: these soldiers are insects, not troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldier ants live in a mound nest, so it is where these soldiers are housed.

clue.text: Advanced study about to get attention in school

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: in means the attention piece goes inside the school piece

parts.note: an ear means attention, as in to lend an ear

explanation.surface: Higher study about to get some notice at school.
explanation.definitionFit: Detailed investigation to discover new facts is study at an advanced level.

clue.text: Escape notice in the preceding period

indicators.note: in means the notice goes inside the period

parts.note: eve is the period just before an event
an ad is a notice, an advertisement

explanation.surface: Slipping past without being noticed just before something happens.
explanation.definitionFit: To elude or avoid something is to escape it.

clue.text: Looks impressive in topless dresses

indicators.note: topless in a down clue means the word loses its top, its first letter

parts.note: frocks are dresses

explanation.surface: Someone cuts a fine figure in revealing dresses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' sounds racy but only removes the first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: In slang, something that rocks is excellent or impressive.

clue.text: A lot of motorcycling has passion for gear

parts.note: the TT is the Isle of Man Tourist Trophy, a long motorcycle race
ire is anger, a passion

explanation.surface: A keen biker's enthusiasm for riding kit.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing or dress is one's gear, as in sports gear.

clue.text: Power in tractor turning over material for road

indicators.note: in means the power piece goes inside the next
turning over means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a Cat is a Caterpillar tractor
arm means power, as in the arm of the law

explanation.surface: A powerful tractor overturns on the road surface.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning over' makes CAT into TAC, and ARM goes 'in' it.
explanation.definitionFit: Asphalt made from tar and stone is used to surface roads.

clue.text: Sporting giants circling rink ultimately displaying this

definitions.text: Sporting giants circling rink ultimately displaying this

indicators.note: circling means the rearranged letters go round the next piece
sporting means the letters are playfully rearranged
ultimately means only the last letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Big sports stars showing off their moves around an ice rink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sporting' rearranges GIANTS; 'circling' puts that round K, the end of RINK. The whole clue also describes what happens on a rink.
explanation.definitionFit: Gliding on blades over ice is what people at a rink display.

clue.text: Disorder, note, or issue with rioting

indicators.note: rioting means the letters run wild into a new order

explanation.surface: A list of problems: disorder, a memo, or trouble with riots.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rioting' rearranges OR and ISSUE into EUROSIS.
explanation.definitionFit: An anxiety-based mental illness is a psychological disorder.

clue.text: Good weather surrounding start of loud cheers for ruler

indicators.note: surrounding means the weather piece goes round the others

parts.note: sun means fine weather

indicators.note: start of means only the first letter of the word is taken

parts.note: ta is British informal for thanks, cheers

explanation.surface: Sunshine and loud cheering greet a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: A Muslim sovereign holds this title, so he is a ruler.
